events.title: The date is set. Relicta in Memoriam arrives November 2nd!

events.title: Relicta In Memoriam is joining Steam Next Fest this October!!
events.summary: We're officially part of Steam Next Fest! 🕯️The wait is almost over, Relicta In Memoriam will be taking part in Steam Next Fest, from October 19 to 26!Set in 1930s Italy, Relicta In Memoriam follows Lucio, a detective drawn into a case that has nothing to do with the world we think we know. Behind the fog and the folklore of the countryside, something ancient is watching, and it doesn't care much for the rules of the living.2.5D pixel art with a slow-burning noir atmosphere.
